{{Otheruses|Commander}}
'''Taskforce commander''', abbreviated as '''TC''', was a command position used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. Taskforce commanders were place in command of [[Task force/Legends|taskforces]]; they were generally temporary commands for the duration of the mission and were based on ability. Taskforce commander was not a coveted position as the individual was ultimately responsible for the success of the taskforce's mission.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

Taskforce commanders were usually of the rank appropriate for the taskforce size. [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]]-sized taskforces were headed by a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], while [[Company/Legends|company]]-level taskforces were commanded by [[Captain/Legends|captains]] or [[Major/Legends|majors]].<ref name="ROE" />
